meals.imageAlt: Photograph of bowl of lemony yogurt topped with crispy spiced chickpeas, feta, and fresh herbs
meals.headnote: Use a wide bowl for Crispy Spiced Chickpea and Feta Bowl so chickpeas and smoked paprika have room to stay distinct. Season the base first and taste again after the toppings are in place.
meals.seoTitle: Crispy Spiced Chickpea and Feta Bowl Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Crispy spiced chickpeas over lemony yogurt with feta and herbs. Deeply satisfying. Made for one in 30 minutes, with chickpeas and smoked paprika.
meals.substitutions: This bowl survives substitutions well. Trade chickpeas for tofu, a fried egg, or last night's vegetables and keep the sauce constant.
meals.storage: Refrigerate leftovers for up to three days with wet elements separate when possible. Reheat the base gently, then add chickpeas and smoked paprika after warming.

meals.name: Peanut Butter Sesame Noodles
meals.description: Sesame peanut sauce over noodles. The most satisfying thing you can make in 15 minutes.

ingredients.name: spring onion, sesame seeds, cucumber ribbons

steps.name: Make sauce
steps.text: Whisk the 2 tablespoons of peanut butter, 1 tablespoon of soy sauce, 1 tablespoon of rice vinegar, 1 teaspoon of sesame oil, 1 teaspoon of honey, and sriracha. Thin with warm water until it is pourable.

steps.name: Cook and toss
steps.text: Boil the 100g of noodles per package, drain, and toss immediately with the sauce. Top with spring onions, sesame seeds, and cucumber ribbons.

meals.notes: Natural peanut butter works best. The sauce keeps refrigerated for a week. Make double.
meals.photo_search: bowl of soba noodles in peanut sesame sauce, topped with spring onions and cucumber ribbons
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of bowl of soba noodles in peanut sesame sauce, topped with spring onions and cucumber ribbons
meals.headnote: The trick in Peanut Butter Sesame Noodles is coating every strand instead of leaving the sauce underneath. Keep a little cooking water nearby and add peanut butter only after the noodles are tender.
meals.seoTitle: Peanut Butter Sesame Noodles Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Sesame peanut sauce over noodles. The most satisfying thing you can make in 15 minutes. A noodles recipe for one, ready in 15 minutes with peanut butter.
meals.substitutions: Sauce bases swap freely if you are out of peanut butter: peanut butter thinned with hot water, tahini plus soy, or simply more chilli oil each carry a bowl.
meals.storage: Refrigerate the noodles for up to one day and protect peanut butter and soy sauce from moisture. They can be eaten cold or revived briefly in hot water before serving.

meals.name: Guacamole and Tortilla Chips
meals.description: A single-avocado guacamole with lime, red onion, jalapeño, cilantro, and crisp tortilla chips.

steps.name: Mash
steps.text: Halve the 1 large ripe avocado, remove the pit, and scoop the flesh into a bowl. Mash with a fork to your preferred texture.

steps.name: Season
steps.text: Add the juice of 1/4 lime, 2 tablespoons of finely diced red onion, 1 tablespoon of minced jalapeño, cilantro, and a generous pinch of salt. Taste and adjust, then serve immediately with tortilla chips.

meals.notes: Add half the lime first, then taste. Too much acid can flatten the avocado flavor, while enough salt should make the lime and chile taste brighter.
meals.photo_search: rustic bowl of chunky guacamole served with tortilla chips
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of rustic bowl of chunky guacamole served with tortilla chips
meals.headnote: A ripe avocado should yield gently at the stem end without feeling hollow or mushy. Mash it only until chunky, season before adding the onion and jalapeño, and keep the chips separate until each bite is scooped.
meals.seoTitle: Guacamole and Tortilla Chips Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Make guacamole and tortilla chips for one with avocado, lime, red onion, jalapeño, and cilantro. Ready in about 8 minutes.
meals.substitutions: Use lemon if lime is unavailable, scallion instead of red onion, or a pinch of chilli flakes instead of jalapeño. For a larger meal, add black beans, crumbled queso fresco, or a fried egg alongside the guacamole.
meals.storage: Guacamole is best the day it is made. Press reusable wrap directly against the surface and refrigerate for up to one day; the close contact slows browning. Keep tortilla chips sealed separately.

meals.name: Sleepy Girl Mocktail
meals.description: Tart cherry juice and sparkling water make a bright, fizzy mocktail with an optional magnesium addition.

ingredients.name: sparkling water or prebiotic soda (Olipop, Poppi)

steps.name: Mix
steps.text: Fill a glass with ice. Pour in 1/2 cup of tart cherry juice and stir in 1 scoop of magnesium powder until completely dissolved. Top with sparkling water or prebiotic soda. Garnish with a lime wedge.

meals.notes: Magnesium is optional. If you use it, follow the serving directions on the package and stir until the powder is fully dissolved.
meals.photo_search: glass of iced tart cherry juice mixed with sparkling water, garnished with lime
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of glass of iced tart cherry juice mixed with sparkling water, garnished with lime
meals.headnote: Chill the ingredients for Sleepy Girl Mocktail first so the ice does not have to do all the work. Stir magnesium powder smooth, then add the bubbles or final garnish gently.
meals.seoTitle: Sleepy Girl Mocktail Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Tart cherry juice and sparkling water make a bright, fizzy mocktail with an optional magnesium addition.
meals.substitutions: The base swaps freely: if magnesium powder is unavailable, any juice or syrup in the same flavor family keeps the balance. Build strong, pour over ice, adjust after one sip.
meals.storage: Build this drink fresh. Keep the juice or syrup base covered for up to two days, then add magnesium powder, ice, and any bubbles only at serving time.

meals.name: Cold Sesame Noodles
meals.description: Room temperature noodles in a nutty, gingery sauce. Better cold than hot.

ingredients.name: shredded cucumber, sesame seeds, spring onion, chilli oil

steps.name: Cook and cool
steps.text: Boil the 100g of noodles per package, then rinse under cold water until completely cool. Drain well.

steps.name: Sauce and toss
steps.text: Whisk the 2 tablespoons of tahini, 1 tablespoon of soy, 1 tablespoon of rice vinegar, 1 teaspoon of grated ginger, and 1 teaspoon of sesame oil. Thin with water until silky. Toss the cold noodles with the sauce. Top with shredded cucumber, spring onions, sesame seeds, and a swirl of chilli oil.

meals.notes: The sauce should look slightly loose before it meets the noodles. Chilled noodles absorb moisture quickly, and a stiff sauce will turn pasty instead of silky.
meals.photo_search: bowl of cold noodles in dark sesame sauce, topped with cucumber, spring onions, and chilli oil
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of bowl of cold noodles in dark sesame sauce, topped with cucumber, spring onions, and chilli oil
meals.headnote: Rinse the cooked noodles until they are genuinely cool, then drain them very well so water does not dilute the sesame sauce. Thin the sauce separately until it falls from a spoon in a ribbon before tossing.
meals.seoTitle: Cold Sesame Noodles Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Room temperature noodles in a nutty, gingery sauce. Better cold than hot. A noodles recipe for one, ready in 18 minutes with tahini or sesame paste.
meals.substitutions: Chinese sesame paste gives the deepest toasted flavor, but tahini or smooth peanut butter also works. Use rice noodles for a gluten-free bowl and tamari in place of soy sauce. Shredded carrot can replace cucumber.
meals.storage: Refrigerate dressed noodles in a sealed container for up to two days. The sauce thickens when cold, so loosen each serving with a teaspoon of water and toss again before eating.

meals.name: Prosciutto and Melon
meals.description: The Italian classic that needs no recipe. Sweet cantaloupe and salty prosciutto.

steps.name: Plate
steps.text: Lay the 1/4 sliced ripe cantaloupe on a plate. Drape the 3 to 4 slices of prosciutto over each slice. Drizzle with olive oil, add black pepper and flaky salt. Add fresh mint or arugula if using.

meals.notes: Only works with truly ripe, fragrant melon. If the melon is not sweet, this dish is pointless.
meals.photo_search: plate of cantaloupe melon slices wrapped in prosciutto, garnished with black pepper
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of plate of cantaloupe melon slices wrapped in prosciutto, garnished with black pepper
meals.headnote: The arrangement is part of Prosciutto and Melon. Leave ripe cantaloupe melon and prosciutto di Parma in their own spaces, then let the creamy, crisp, and briny parts meet in different combinations.
meals.seoTitle: Prosciutto and Melon Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: The Italian classic that needs no recipe. Sweet cantaloupe and salty prosciutto. A snack plate recipe for one, ready in 5 minutes with ripe cantaloupe melon.
meals.substitutions: No ripe cantaloupe melon? Any cheese, hummus, or tinned fish can anchor the plate. Keep one creamy thing, one crisp thing, and one briny thing and the board still works.
meals.storage: The assembled plate loses its contrast in the fridge. Chill ripe cantaloupe melon in a covered container, keep prosciutto di Parma sealed on its own, and rebuild the portions at serving time.

meals.name: Spinach Artichoke Dip with Pita Chips
meals.description: Warm, cheesy, bubbly dip made in 20 minutes. The shareable girl dinner.

ingredients.name: frozen spinach, thawed and squeezed dry
marinated artichoke hearts, drained and chopped

steps.name: Mix
steps.text: Combine the 1/2 cup of thawed and squeezed spinach, 1/2 cup of chopped artichoke hearts, 100g of cream cheese, 3 tablespoons of sour cream, 40g of grated parmesan, and 1 clove of minced garlic in an oven safe dish. Stir to combine.

steps.name: Bake
steps.text: Bake at 375F/190C for 20 minutes until bubbly and golden. Broil for 2 minutes for extra color.

steps.name: Dip
steps.text: Let the dip stand for 2 minutes, then set the hot dish on a heatproof board. Serve with pita chips or sturdy crackers while the center is still creamy and the top is browned.

meals.notes: Squeezing every drop of water from the spinach is essential. Otherwise the dip gets watery.
meals.photo_search: bubbling golden spinach and artichoke dip served with pita chips
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of bubbling golden spinach and artichoke dip served with pita chips
meals.headnote: A wide dish makes Spinach Artichoke Dip with Pita Chips feel generous. Spread it out, add frozen spinach as the sharp or savory finish, and bring the crisp things to the table separately.
meals.seoTitle: Spinach Artichoke Dip with Pita Chips Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Warm, cheesy, bubbly dip made in 20 minutes. The shareable girl dinner. Made for one in 25 minutes, with frozen spinach and marinated artichoke hearts.
meals.substitutions: Jarred artichoke hearts in water work if marinated ones are unavailable; drain them thoroughly and add an extra teaspoon of olive oil. Kale can replace spinach, and Greek yogurt can replace sour cream.
meals.storage: Refrigerate in a sealed container for up to four days. Stir before serving and refresh the surface with frozen spinach or a little olive oil if it tightens.

meals.name: Lox Plate on Cucumber
meals.description: Smoked salmon, cream cheese, capers, and cucumber deliver all the familiar lox flavors without a bagel.

ingredients.name: English cucumber, sliced into thick rounds

steps.name: Build bites
steps.text: Slice the 1 large English cucumber into thick rounds. Spread 3 tablespoons of cream cheese on each round. Top with a small piece of the 80g of lox, 1 tablespoon of capers, a paper thin slice of red onion, and a sprig of dill.

meals.notes: These also work beautifully on endive leaves for a more elegant presentation.
meals.photo_search: cucumber rounds topped with cream cheese, smoked salmon, capers, red onion, and dill
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of cucumber rounds topped with cream cheese, smoked salmon, capers, red onion, and dill
meals.headnote: Lox Plate on Cucumber works because the bite keeps changing: English cucumber gives it an anchor and smoked salmon brings contrast. Keep the pieces distinct and build each forkful as you go.
meals.seoTitle: Lox Plate on Cucumber Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Smoked salmon, cream cheese, capers, and cucumber deliver all the familiar lox flavors without a bagel.
meals.substitutions: No English cucumber? Any cheese, hummus, or tinned fish can anchor the plate. Keep one creamy thing, one crisp thing, and one briny thing and the board still works.
meals.storage: Store the pieces of this plate separately for up to two days. Cover English cucumber, protect smoked salmon from moisture, and bring everything together only when you are ready to eat.

meals.name: Adult Lunchable Plate
meals.description: Exactly what you think. Crackers, deli meat, cheese, grapes, a little candy if you want.

ingredients.name: baby carrots, apple slices, a few M&Ms

steps.name: Separate and plate
steps.text: Keep everything in distinct piles on a plate. Put the handful of crackers on one side, 3 to 4 slices of deli turkey on another, and 40g of cubed cheddar in the middle. Add grapes, baby carrots, or apple slices in the gaps. No mixing required.

meals.notes: The joy is in the separateness. You eat each thing on its own or build your own stack.
meals.photo_search: plate with distinct piles of crackers, deli turkey, cheddar cheese, and red grapes
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of plate with distinct piles of crackers, deli turkey, cheddar cheese, and red grapes
meals.headnote: Treat Adult Lunchable Plate like a small composed meal. Put Ritz or Triscuit crackers at the center, use deli turkey or ham to keep the plate lively, and add the sharp or salty finish just before eating.
meals.seoTitle: Adult Lunchable Plate Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Exactly what you think. Crackers, deli meat, cheese, grapes, a little candy if you want.
meals.substitutions: Swap Ritz or Triscuit crackers for whatever is already open in the fridge, and let deli turkey or ham keep its original contrast. The formula matters more than the parts: substance, crunch, and something sharp to cut through.
meals.storage: The assembled plate loses its contrast in the fridge. Chill Ritz or Triscuit crackers in a covered container, keep deli turkey or ham sealed on its own, and rebuild the portions at serving time.

meals.name: Garlic Parmesan Toast
meals.description: The simplest, most satisfying thing. Crispy garlic toast with melted parmesan.

steps.name: Make garlic butter
steps.text: Mix the 2 tablespoons of softened butter, 2 cloves of minced garlic, and 3 tablespoons of grated parmesan until combined.

steps.name: Toast
steps.text: Spread the mixture thickly on 2 slices of crusty bread. Broil for 3 to 4 minutes until the edges are golden and the parmesan is crispy. Add fresh parsley and chilli flakes.

meals.notes: Broiling rather than baking gives you the best crispy outside, soft inside texture.
meals.photo_search: toasted crusty bread topped with melted garlic butter and crispy parmesan
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of toasted crusty bread topped with melted garlic butter and crispy parmesan
meals.headnote: Build Garlic Parmesan Toast in the order the textures need. Get the bread crisp, season salted butter directly, and save garlic for the final pass so every bite has some snap.
meals.seoTitle: Garlic Parmesan Toast Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: The simplest, most satisfying thing. Crispy garlic toast with melted parmesan. Made for one in 11 minutes, with salted butter and garlic.
meals.substitutions: No salted butter? Soft cheeses, mashed avocado, or ricotta play the same role, while garlic can keep the topping interesting. Whatever the spread, season it directly instead of salting only the top.
meals.storage: Toast cannot be stored assembled. Keep salted butter and garlic covered away from the bread, then toast a fresh slice and rebuild it when you are ready.

meals.name: Cherry Tomato and Mozzarella Pasta
meals.description: Fresh blistered tomato sauce with torn mozzarella that melts into hot pasta. Summer simplicity.

steps.name: Blister tomatoes
steps.text: Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil over high heat. Add the 200g of cherry tomatoes and let them blister and burst, about 5 minutes. Add 2 cloves of sliced garlic and chilli flakes, cooking 1 minute.

steps.name: Cook pasta
steps.text: Boil the 100g of pasta in well salted water until al dente, saving a splash of pasta water.

steps.name: Combine
steps.text: Toss the pasta with the tomatoes and a splash of pasta water. Remove from heat. Add 80g of torn mozzarella and basil. The residual heat melts the cheese.

meals.notes: Tearing the mozzarella rather than slicing gives you irregular melty pockets throughout the pasta.
meals.photo_search: bowl of rigatoni pasta with blistered cherry tomatoes, torn mozzarella, and fresh basil
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of bowl of rigatoni pasta with blistered cherry tomatoes, torn mozzarella, and fresh basil
meals.headnote: Finish Cherry Tomato and Mozzarella Pasta with the heat off if the sauce is already glossy. cherry tomatoes should stay recognizable, while garlic helps the single bowl taste complete rather than heavy.
meals.seoTitle: Cherry Tomato and Mozzarella Pasta Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Fresh blistered tomato sauce with torn mozzarella that melts into hot pasta. Summer simplicity. Made for one in 20 minutes, with cherry tomatoes and garlic.
meals.substitutions: Sauce components swap freely: if cherry tomatoes is out, any bold condiment thinned with pasta water (pesto, tapenade, chilli crisp) leads the bowl instead.
meals.storage: The sauce keeps covered for two days, while the pasta is best revived in a pan over low heat. Add garlic after warming so its flavor stays clear.

meals.name: Edamame with Garlic Butter and Chilli
meals.description: Steamed edamame tossed with garlic butter and chilli makes a salty, hands-on snack dinner.

steps.name: Cook edamame
steps.text: Microwave or boil the 1 cup of edamame pods until hot, then drain.

steps.name: Toss
steps.text: Melt 1 tablespoon of butter in a pan, add 1 clove of minced garlic and a pinch of chilli flakes for 30 seconds. Toss the edamame in the garlic butter and season with flaky sea salt.

meals.notes: Eat by popping the beans directly into your mouth from the pod. The tactile experience is part of it.
meals.photo_search: bowl of edamame pods tossed in garlic butter, chilli flakes, and flaky sea salt
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of bowl of edamame pods tossed in garlic butter, chilli flakes, and flaky sea salt
meals.headnote: Steam the edamame only until hot and bright green, then dry the pods before tossing so the garlic butter clings. Bloom the garlic and chilli gently and pull the pan before the garlic browns.
meals.seoTitle: Edamame with Garlic Butter and Chilli Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Steamed edamame tossed with garlic butter and chilli makes a salty, hands-on snack dinner.
meals.substitutions: Missing frozen edamame in pods? Any sturdy cracker-worthy substitute works. The point is contrast between bites, not exact replication.
meals.storage: For leftovers, cool any cooked parts promptly and store them away from the crisp finish. Reheat frozen edamame in pods gently and add salted butter only at the table.

meals.name: Elevated Canned Tomato Soup
meals.description: Turn one can of tomato soup into a richer bowl with cream, butter, basil oil, and crisp crackers.

ingredients.name: quality tomato soup or bisque (Rao's or Amy's)
basil oil or good olive oil

steps.name: Heat and enrich
steps.text: Warm the 1 can of tomato soup in a saucepan over medium heat. Stir in 2 tablespoons of heavy cream and 1 tablespoon of butter until completely melted and incorporated.

steps.name: Serve
steps.text: Pour into a mug or bowl, drizzle with basil oil, and add crackers or croutons with flaky salt.

meals.notes: Taste before seasoning because canned soup brands differ in salt and sweetness. A small squeeze of lemon can sharpen a soup that tastes flat.
meals.photo_search: mug of creamy tomato soup topped with croutons and a drizzle of olive oil
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of mug of creamy tomato soup topped with croutons and a drizzle of olive oil
meals.headnote: Warm canned tomato soup over medium-low heat so the cream stays smooth and the bottom does not scorch. Stir in the butter after the soup is hot, then finish each bowl with basil oil and something crisp.
meals.seoTitle: Elevated Canned Tomato Soup Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Upgrade canned tomato soup with cream, butter, basil oil, and crunchy crackers. A richer single-serving bowl ready in about 10 minutes.
meals.substitutions: Half-and-half or unsweetened oat cream can replace heavy cream. Use pesto or good olive oil if basil oil is unavailable. Grilled bread, croutons, or a cheese toast can stand in for crackers.
meals.storage: Refrigerate leftover soup in a sealed container for up to three days. Reheat over medium-low heat, stirring often, and avoid a hard boil so the dairy does not separate.

meals.name: Tuna Salad on Crackers
meals.description: A proper tuna salad. Mayo, celery, dijon, capers. Scooped onto crackers.

ingredients.name: quality tuna in olive oil (Wild Planet or Ortiz)

steps.name: Mix
steps.text: Drain the 1 can of tuna and combine with 2 tablespoons of mayo, 1 finely diced celery stalk, 1 teaspoon of dijon, 1 tablespoon of chopped capers, and lemon juice. Season with black pepper and mix well. Taste and adjust.

steps.name: Plate
steps.text: Serve alongside a pile of crackers for scooping, then finish with the listed garnishes. Serve right away while the hot ingredients are hot and the crisp ingredients still have their texture.

meals.notes: Quality tuna makes a huge difference. Ortiz in olive oil is in a completely different league from generic supermarket tuna.
meals.photo_search: bowl of tuna salad with celery and capers, served alongside a pile of crackers
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of bowl of tuna salad with celery and capers, served alongside a pile of crackers
meals.headnote: A small snack still deserves attention. Let quality tuna carry the bite, use mayonnaise for contrast, and add the salt, heat, or acid while the food is at its best.
meals.seoTitle: Tuna Salad on Crackers Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: A proper tuna salad. Mayo, celery, dijon, capers. Scooped onto crackers. A snack recipe for one, ready in 8 minutes with quality tuna.
meals.substitutions: Missing quality tuna? Any sturdy cracker-worthy substitute works. The point is contrast between bites, not exact replication.
meals.storage: Keep quality tuna and mayonnaise in separate containers if saving a portion. Refrigerate overnight at most, then restore the crunch or warmth before serving.

meals.name: Goat Cheese Toast with Honey and Walnuts
meals.description: Tangy goat cheese on toasted bread with honey. Easy, satisfying, and kind of impressive.

ingredients.name: sliced figs or pears, fresh thyme

steps.name: Spread
steps.text: Spread 60g of soft goat cheese generously on the 2 slices of toasted sourdough.

steps.name: Top
steps.text: Drizzle with 1 tablespoon of good honey, scatter 2 tablespoons of toasted walnuts, and add fresh thyme if using.

meals.notes: Room temperature goat cheese spreads much more easily than cold. The combination of honey and goat cheese is very nearly perfect.
meals.photo_search: sourdough toast spread with goat cheese, drizzled with honey, and topped with walnuts
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of sourdough toast spread with goat cheese, drizzled with honey, and topped with walnuts
meals.headnote: A thick slice turns soft goat cheese and good honey into a proper one-person meal. Watch the color of the bread rather than the clock, then assemble while the surface still crackles.
meals.seoTitle: Goat Cheese Toast with Honey and Walnuts | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Tangy goat cheese on toasted bread with honey. Easy, satisfying, and kind of impressive. Made for one in 6 minutes, with soft goat cheese and good honey.
meals.substitutions: Out of soft goat cheese? Try good honey instead, or use any combination of something creamy over something briny. Thick bread forgives almost any topping swap.
meals.storage: Make the components ahead, not the finished toast. Cover soft goat cheese, protect good honey from moisture, and assemble after the bread is hot and crisp.

meals.name: Shakshuka for One
meals.description: Eggs poached in spiced tomato sauce. A dramatic, satisfying pan dinner.

steps.name: Build sauce
steps.text: Saute the half diced onion in olive oil until soft, 5 minutes. Add 2 cloves of minced garlic, 1 teaspoon of cumin, 1 teaspoon of smoked paprika, and half a teaspoon of chilli flakes, cooking 1 minute. Pour in the 1 can of diced tomatoes and simmer 10 minutes until thickened. Season generously.

steps.name: Add eggs
steps.text: Make wells in the sauce with a spoon. Crack the 2 large eggs into the wells. Cover and cook 5 to 7 minutes until whites are set but yolks runny.

steps.name: Serve
steps.text: Top with feta and parsley. Eat directly from the pan with crusty bread for dipping.

meals.notes: Serve directly from the pan. It looks dramatic and saves a dish.
meals.photo_search: cast iron skillet of shakshuka with eggs poached in spiced tomato sauce, topped with feta
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of cast iron skillet of shakshuka with eggs poached in spiced tomato sauce, topped with feta
meals.headnote: Gentle heat does the important work in Shakshuka for One. Pull the pan when the eggs are barely set, then let diced tomatoes and the residual warmth finish the dish.
meals.seoTitle: Shakshuka for One Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Eggs poached in spiced tomato sauce. A dramatic, satisfying pan dinner. Made for one in 25 minutes, with diced tomatoes and onion.
meals.substitutions: Mix-ins trade freely here: if diced tomatoes is not on hand, any leftover vegetable, cheese, or fresh herb folds in at the same stage. Eggs forgive improvisation.
meals.storage: Eggs are best straight from the pan. Cover leftovers for one day and warm them gently over low heat, adding diced tomatoes only after the center is hot.

meals.name: Cacio e Pepe
meals.description: Only three ingredients but requires technique. Cheese, pepper, and pasta water do everything.

steps.name: Toast pepper
steps.text: Toast 1.5 teaspoons of cracked pepper in a dry pan until fragrant. Boil 100g of pasta in salted water until 2 minutes before done, saving a cup of water.

steps.name: Make sauce
steps.text: Transfer pasta to the pepper pan over medium heat, adding pasta water gradually. Remove from heat, add 50g of pecorino and 20g of parmesan, and toss vigorously until emulsified into a silky sauce.

meals.notes: Taking the pan off heat before adding cheese prevents it from seizing. The pasta water emulsion is the entire technique.
meals.photo_search: bowl of spaghetti in a silky black pepper and pecorino sauce
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of bowl of spaghetti in a silky black pepper and pecorino sauce
meals.headnote: Use one pot and one generous appetite for Cacio e Pepe. Pull the pasta while it still has a little bite, then let Parmigiano-Reggiano and the starchy water finish the texture in the pan.
meals.seoTitle: Cacio e Pepe Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Only three ingredients but requires technique. Cheese, pepper, and pasta water do everything.
meals.substitutions: Sauce components swap freely: if Pecorino Romano is out, any bold condiment thinned with pasta water (pesto, tapenade, chilli crisp) leads the bowl instead.
meals.storage: The sauce keeps covered for two days, while the pasta is best revived in a pan over low heat. Add Parmigiano-Reggiano after warming so its flavor stays clear.

meals.name: Tinned Fish Board
meals.description: The elevated pantry dinner. Sardines, smoked oysters, arranged on a board with all the accompaniments.

steps.name: Open and arrange
steps.text: Open the 1 tin of sardines and 1 tin of smoked oysters and place them directly on a board. Arrange crackers, 2 tablespoons of creme fraiche, 1 tablespoon of dijon mustard, cornichons, and capers around them. Add a lemon wedge.

meals.notes: The open tins are part of the aesthetic. Place them directly on the board. Fishwife and Ortiz are the top brands.
meals.photo_search: wooden board with open tins of sardines and oysters, crackers, cornichons, and mustard
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of wooden board with open tins of sardines and oysters, crackers, cornichons, and mustard
meals.headnote: The arrangement is part of Tinned Fish Board. Leave sardines and smoked oysters or mussels in their own spaces, then let the creamy, crisp, and briny parts meet in different combinations.
meals.seoTitle: Tinned Fish Board Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: The elevated pantry dinner. Sardines, smoked oysters, arranged on a board with all the accompaniments.
meals.substitutions: No sardines? Any cheese, hummus, or tinned fish can anchor the plate. Keep one creamy thing, one crisp thing, and one briny thing and the board still works.
meals.storage: The assembled plate loses its contrast in the fridge. Chill sardines in a covered container, keep smoked oysters or mussels sealed on its own, and rebuild the portions at serving time.

meals.name: Avocado and Egg Salad Lettuce Cups
meals.description: Creamy mashed avocado and chopped egg in crisp lettuce. Fresh, filling, no bread needed.

steps.name: Make filling
steps.text: Combine 1 mashed ripe avocado, 2 chopped hard boiled eggs, 1 teaspoon of dijon, lemon juice, and 2 finely diced celery stalks. Season well.

steps.name: Fill cups
steps.text: Spoon the mixture into 4 to 6 crisp butter lettuce leaves and dust with paprika.

meals.notes: The avocado supplies all the creaminess the filling needs. Keep the lettuce leaves cold and dry so they stay crisp.
meals.photo_search: crisp lettuce leaves filled with creamy avocado and chopped egg salad, dusted with paprika
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of crisp lettuce leaves filled with creamy avocado and chopped egg salad, dusted with paprika
meals.headnote: The method for Avocado and Egg Salad Lettuce Cups is mostly tasting. Start with the dressing, add eggs, and keep enough ripe avocado in reserve to restore crunch and brightness at the end.
meals.seoTitle: Avocado and Egg Salad Lettuce Cups Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Creamy mashed avocado and chopped egg in crisp lettuce. Fresh, filling, no bread needed. Made for one in 18 minutes, with eggs and ripe avocado.
meals.substitutions: Greens swap freely by season. Without eggs, toasted nuts or seeds restore the crunch the salad is counting on.
meals.storage: Store the dressed and crisp parts separately for up to two days. Keep eggs covered, protect ripe avocado from the dressing, and combine at the table.

meals.name: Kimchi Butter Ramen
meals.description: Shin Ramyun with kimchi, butter, and a soft egg. The Korean midnight snack elevated.

ingredients.name: spring onion, sesame seeds, nori strips

steps.name: Cook noodles
steps.text: Cook the 1 packet of noodles per instructions. In the last minute, add 1/4 cup of chopped kimchi and 1 tablespoon of kimchi juice.

steps.name: Finish
steps.text: Stir in 1 tablespoon of butter until melted. Fry or poach the 1 large egg separately. Top the noodles with the egg, spring onions, and sesame seeds.

meals.notes: Aged kimchi (the sour stuff in the back of the fridge) works best. Its fermented tang cuts through the richness.
meals.photo_search: bowl of ramen with kimchi, butter, an egg, and spring onions
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of bowl of ramen with kimchi, butter, an egg, and spring onions
meals.headnote: Have the sauce ready before the noodles for Kimchi Butter Ramen are drained. Toss while everything is hot, then finish with kimchi so the strands stay loose and seasoned.
meals.seoTitle: Kimchi Butter Ramen Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Shin Ramyun with kimchi, butter, and a soft egg. The Korean midnight snack elevated. A noodles recipe for one, ready in 9 minutes with kimchi.
meals.substitutions: Sauce bases swap freely if you are out of kimchi: peanut butter thinned with hot water, tahini plus soy, or simply more chilli oil each carry a bowl.
meals.storage: Refrigerate the noodles for up to one day and protect kimchi and butter from moisture. They can be eaten cold or revived briefly in hot water before serving.

meals.name: Medjool Dates with Almond Butter and Flaky Salt
meals.description: Nature's candy stuffed with almond butter. The sweet salty snack that feels indulgent.

ingredients.name: dark chocolate drizzle, toasted almonds inside

steps.name: Stuff
steps.text: Slice the 4 to 5 Medjool dates lengthways and remove the pits. Fill each with a spoonful of 2 tablespoons of almond butter. Pinch closed slightly.

steps.name: Finish
steps.text: Arrange on a plate, sprinkle with flaky sea salt, and drizzle with dark chocolate if using.

meals.notes: The viral date bark trend started here. These also freeze well for a cold caramel like snack.
meals.photo_search: plate of Medjool dates stuffed with almond butter and sprinkled with flaky sea salt
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of plate of Medjool dates stuffed with almond butter and sprinkled with flaky sea salt
meals.headnote: The method for Medjool Dates with Almond Butter and Flaky Salt is short because the ingredients already know what they are doing. Give Medjool dates enough heat or seasoning, then finish with almond butter.
meals.seoTitle: Medjool Dates with Almond Butter and Flaky Salt | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Nature's candy stuffed with almond butter. The sweet salty snack that feels indulgent. Made for one in 5 minutes, with Medjool dates and almond butter.
meals.substitutions: Medjool dates can become whatever you have on hand. Keep portions honest for one and season louder than you think for such a small plate.
meals.storage: For leftovers, cool any cooked parts promptly and store them away from the crisp finish. Reheat Medjool dates gently and add almond butter only at the table.

meals.name: Sheet Pan Nachos
meals.description: Maximum chip to topping ratio achieved by spreading everything on one tray.

ingredients.name: sour cream, salsa, guacamole, hot sauce

steps.name: Layer
steps.text: Spread 2 large handfuls of tortilla chips in a single layer on a baking sheet. Scatter 1/4 can of drained black beans, 2 tablespoons of pickled jalapenos, and 80g of shredded cheese over every chip.

steps.name: Bake
steps.text: Bake at 400°F (200°C) for 8 to 12 minutes, until the cheese is fully melted and bubbling and the exposed edges of the chips have deepened in color.

steps.name: Top and eat
steps.text: Add cold sour cream and salsa. Eat directly from the tray.

meals.notes: Eat straight from the sheet pan. It keeps them crispy and saves a dish.
meals.photo_search: sheet pan of tortilla chips loaded with melted cheese, jalapenos, and black beans
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of sheet pan of tortilla chips loaded with melted cheese, jalapenos, and black beans
meals.headnote: A small snack still deserves attention. Let Monterey Jack or cheddar carry the bite, use black beans for contrast, and add the salt, heat, or acid while the food is at its best.
meals.seoTitle: Sheet Pan Nachos Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Maximum chip to topping ratio achieved by spreading everything on one tray. Made for one in 17 minutes, with Monterey Jack or cheddar and black beans.
meals.substitutions: Missing Monterey Jack or cheddar? Any sturdy cracker-worthy substitute works. The point is contrast between bites, not exact replication.
meals.storage: This is best straight away. If Monterey Jack or cheddar or black beans needs to wait, cover it separately for one day and reassemble so the crisp parts do not soften.

meals.name: Miso Soup with Tofu and Noodles
meals.description: Warm, savory, deeply comforting. A proper miso broth with noodles and soft tofu.

steps.name: Make broth
steps.text: Bring 2 cups of water or dashi to a gentle simmer. Add the cubed tofu and warm for 2 minutes, then remove the pan from the heat. Mix 2 tablespoons of miso with a ladleful of hot broth in a small bowl until smooth, then stir it back into the pan with the soy sauce and sesame oil.

steps.name: Add and serve
steps.text: Cook 1 portion of noodles separately according to the package, drain well, and place in a bowl. Ladle over the miso broth and tofu, then finish with spring onions, nori, and sesame seeds.

meals.notes: Miso loses aroma when boiled. Remove the pan from the heat before adding it, and taste before adding soy sauce because both ingredients contribute salt.
meals.photo_search: bowl of miso soup with silken tofu, noodles, spring onions, and nori
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of bowl of miso soup with silken tofu, noodles, spring onions, and nori
meals.headnote: Cook the noodles separately so they do not cloud or over-thicken the broth. Warm the tofu gently, take the broth off the heat, and dissolve the miso in a ladleful of hot liquid before stirring it back into the pot.
meals.seoTitle: Miso Soup with Tofu and Noodles Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Warm, savory, deeply comforting. A proper miso broth with noodles and soft tofu. A soup recipe for one, ready in 15 minutes with white miso paste.
meals.substitutions: Use red or yellow miso for a stronger broth, starting with one tablespoon and adding more to taste. Firm tofu can replace silken tofu, and soba, somen, or instant ramen noodles all work. Use tamari instead of soy sauce for a gluten-free version.
meals.storage: Store broth, noodles, and tofu separately when possible for up to two days. Reheat the broth gently without boiling, then add the noodles and tofu just long enough to warm through.

meals.name: Hot Honey Butter Toast
meals.description: The most minimal toast possible. Just good bread, real butter, and hot honey.

ingredients.name: thick white bread or brioche, toasted
hot honey (Mike's Hot Honey or homemade)

steps.name: Toast and butter
steps.text: Toast 2 slices of bread until golden. Spread 2 tablespoons of butter generously while still hot so it melts in.

steps.name: Drizzle
steps.text: Drizzle 1 tablespoon of hot honey over the buttery toast and add a pinch of flaky salt.

meals.notes: This sounds almost too simple to be a meal, but the contrast works. Use thick bread and let it get properly crisp before adding the butter.
meals.photo_search: thick toast heavily buttered and drizzled with hot honey and flaky salt
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of thick toast heavily buttered and drizzled with hot honey and flaky salt
meals.headnote: Hot Honey Butter Toast depends on a properly crisp base. Toast the bread until it can support salted butter, add hot honey at the last minute, and eat it before the topping softens the edges.
meals.seoTitle: Hot Honey Butter Toast Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: The most minimal toast possible. Just good bread, real butter, and hot honey. Salted butter and hot honey make this toast recipe for one in 5 minutes.
meals.substitutions: No salted butter? Soft cheeses, mashed avocado, or ricotta play the same role, while hot honey can keep the topping interesting. Whatever the spread, season it directly instead of salting only the top.
meals.storage: Make the components ahead, not the finished toast. Cover salted butter, protect hot honey from moisture, and assemble after the bread is hot and crisp.

meals.name: Loaded Sweet Potato with Black Beans
meals.description: Baked sweet potato with black beans, avocado, and lime crema. A whole satisfying meal.

steps.name: Bake potato
steps.text: Rub 1 large sweet potato with oil and salt, pierce it, and bake at 425F/220C for 45 to 50 minutes until soft.

steps.name: Load
steps.text: Split it open, fluff the inside, and top with 1/2 can of warmed black beans, half a sliced avocado, lime seasoned sour cream, and cilantro.

meals.notes: Season the inside of the potato with salt and a pat of butter before adding toppings.
meals.photo_search: baked sweet potato split open and loaded with black beans, avocado, and lime crema
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of baked sweet potato split open and loaded with black beans, avocado, and lime crema
meals.headnote: The portion in Loaded Sweet Potato with Black Beans is practical without feeling slight. Read the method once, watch for the doneness cue, and keep black beans ready for the hot plate.
meals.seoTitle: Loaded Sweet Potato with Black Beans Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Baked sweet potato with black beans, avocado, and lime crema. A whole satisfying meal. Made for one in 55 minutes, with sweet potato and black beans.
meals.substitutions: Protein here is a suggestion, not a rule. Swap sweet potato freely and let the sauce and timing lead; check doneness a few minutes early either way.
meals.storage: Refrigerate leftovers covered for up to three days. Reheat gently until hot throughout, adding a splash of water if sweet potato or the sauce looks dry.

meals.name: Caramelized Onion Dip with Ridged Chips
meals.description: Caramelized onion dip made from scratch. Vastly superior to the packet kind.

steps.name: Caramelize onions
steps.text: Cook 2 thinly sliced yellow onions in 2 tablespoons of butter with salt over low heat for 30 minutes, stirring occasionally, until deep golden and jammy. Let cool.

steps.name: Make dip
steps.text: Mix 1/2 cup of sour cream, 2 tablespoons of cream cheese, 1 teaspoon of garlic powder, and Worcestershire. Fold in the cooled onions and season.

steps.name: Serve
steps.text: Serve with ridged chips. The dip is better after an hour in the fridge.

meals.notes: You cannot rush caramelized onions. Low and slow for 30 minutes minimum.
meals.photo_search: bowl of creamy caramelized onion dip served with ridged potato chips
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of bowl of creamy caramelized onion dip served with ridged potato chips
meals.headnote: Treat the dip and its scoops as one recipe. Smooth Caramelized Onion Dip with Ridged Chips, season yellow onions carefully, and keep butter close so each bite has both creaminess and crunch.
meals.seoTitle: Caramelized Onion Dip with Ridged Chips | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Caramelized onion dip made from scratch. Vastly superior to the packet kind. A dip recipe for one, ready in 40 minutes with yellow onions.
meals.substitutions: No yellow onions? White beans, roasted eggplant, or extra yogurt blend into an equally dippable base. Taste and re-salt after blending.
meals.storage: This dip keeps covered for four days. Let one portion lose its chill, stir in a teaspoon of water if needed, and add butter only when serving.

meals.name: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio
meals.description: Spaghetti with garlic, olive oil, chilli, and parsley. Italian simplicity at its finest.

ingredients.name: fresh flat leaf parsley, roughly chopped

steps.name: Cook pasta
steps.text: Boil 100g of spaghetti in well salted water until al dente, saving a cup of water.

steps.name: Toast garlic
steps.text: Warm 3 tablespoons of olive oil in a pan over medium heat. Add 4 cloves of sliced garlic and cook slowly until golden. Add 1/2 teaspoon of chilli flakes.

steps.name: Combine
steps.text: Add drained pasta and a splash of pasta water. Toss vigorously until emulsified. Add a large handful of parsley and toss again.

meals.notes: Garlic must be sliced and toasted slowly to golden. Never brown or it becomes bitter.
meals.photo_search: bowl of spaghetti in garlic and olive oil with chilli flakes and fresh parsley
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of bowl of spaghetti in garlic and olive oil with chilli flakes and fresh parsley
meals.headnote: Finish Spaghetti Aglio e Olio with the heat off if the sauce is already glossy. garlic should stay recognizable, while chilli flakes helps the single bowl taste complete rather than heavy.
meals.seoTitle: Spaghetti Aglio e Olio Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Spaghetti with garlic, olive oil, chilli, and parsley. Italian simplicity at its finest. Made for one in 18 minutes, with garlic and chilli flakes.
meals.substitutions: Sauce components swap freely: if garlic is out, any bold condiment thinned with pasta water (pesto, tapenade, chilli crisp) leads the bowl instead.
meals.storage: Cool leftovers promptly and refrigerate for up to two days. Warm them slowly with a little water, then finish with garlic just before serving.

meals.name: Savory Cottage Cheese Bowl
meals.description: Cottage cheese topped with cucumber, tomatoes, everything seasoning, and chilli crisp makes a savory bowl in five minutes.

ingredients.name: sliced avocado, pickled jalapenos, fresh herbs

steps.name: Bowl it
steps.text: Scoop 1 cup of cottage cheese into a wide bowl. Arrange half a diced cucumber and a handful of halved cherry tomatoes on top. Season with 2 tablespoons of everything bagel seasoning, drizzle with olive oil or chilli crisp.

meals.notes: Good Cultures or Kalona Supernatural cottage cheese are notably better than generic brands.
meals.photo_search: bowl of cottage cheese topped with diced cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, and everything bagel seasoning
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of bowl of cottage cheese topped with diced cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, and everything bagel seasoning
meals.headnote: Build Savory Cottage Cheese Bowl in layers instead of stirring it into one texture. Let full fat cottage cheese bring substance and cucumber bring brightness, then add the crunchy finish at the last moment.
meals.seoTitle: Savory Cottage Cheese Bowl Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Cottage cheese topped with cucumber, tomatoes, everything seasoning, and chilli crisp makes a savory bowl in five minutes.
meals.substitutions: Rice, farro, couscous, or frozen grains all make the base. No full fat cottage cheese? Any roasted vegetable or canned bean drops straight in.
meals.storage: Refrigerate leftovers for up to three days with wet elements separate when possible. Reheat the base gently, then add full fat cottage cheese and cucumber after warming.

meals.name: Panzanella
meals.description: Tuscan bread salad. Stale bread soaked in the juices of very ripe tomatoes.

ingredients.name: day old sourdough, torn into chunks

steps.name: Salt tomatoes
steps.text: Season 2 chunked tomatoes generously with salt and let sit 10 minutes. They will release juices.

steps.name: Soak bread
steps.text: Toss 2 slices of torn sourdough, 1/4 thinly sliced red onion, 2 tablespoons of olive oil, and 1 tablespoon of red wine vinegar with the tomatoes. Let sit 5 to 10 minutes so the bread absorbs the juices.

steps.name: Finish
steps.text: Add a handful of fresh basil, toss, and serve at room temperature.

meals.notes: This only works with stale bread and peak season tomatoes. Both requirements are non negotiable.
meals.photo_search: rustic bowl of panzanella salad with torn sourdough, juicy tomatoes, red onion, and basil
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of rustic bowl of panzanella salad with torn sourdough, juicy tomatoes, red onion, and basil
meals.headnote: Panzanella works because the ingredients keep their own texture. Cut day old sourdough into fork-friendly pieces, dress lightly, and let the sharper flavors settle for a minute.
meals.seoTitle: Panzanella Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Tuscan bread salad. Stale bread soaked in the juices of very ripe tomatoes. A salad recipe for one, ready in 15 minutes with day old sourdough.
meals.substitutions: Greens swap freely by season. Without day old sourdough, toasted nuts or seeds restore the crunch the salad is counting on.
meals.storage: The vegetables keep for two days when dry and covered. Hold the dressing apart, then add day old sourdough and taste again just before eating.

meals.name: Matcha Latte and Banana with Peanut Butter
meals.description: The girl dinner that is just a drink and a banana with nut butter. Deeply valid.

ingredients.name: peanut or almond butter for dipping

steps.name: Make matcha
steps.text: Sift 1 teaspoon of matcha into a mug, add 2 oz of hot water, and whisk vigorously until frothy. Pour in 6 oz of warm frothed oat milk.

steps.name: Add oat milk
steps.text: Serve with 1 banana and 2 tablespoons of peanut butter for dipping.

meals.notes: Ceremonial grade matcha is not a luxury. It is the only kind that tastes good when made simply.
meals.photo_search: mug of frothy green matcha latte served with a banana and a side of peanut butter
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of mug of frothy green matcha latte served with a banana and a side of peanut butter
meals.headnote: A small snack still deserves attention. Let ceremonial grade matcha powder carry the bite, use oat milk for contrast, and add the salt, heat, or acid while the food is at its best.
meals.seoTitle: Matcha Latte and Banana with Peanut Butter | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: The girl dinner that is just a drink and a banana with nut butter. Deeply valid. Made for one in 5 minutes, with ceremonial grade matcha powder and oat milk.
meals.substitutions: Missing ceremonial grade matcha powder? Any sturdy cracker-worthy substitute works. The point is contrast between bites, not exact replication.
meals.storage: For leftovers, cool any cooked parts promptly and store them away from the crisp finish. Reheat ceremonial grade matcha powder gently and add oat milk only at the table.

meals.name: White Bean Dip with Lemon and Rosemary
meals.description: Blended white beans with olive oil and lemon. A more interesting alternative to hummus.

steps.name: Blend
steps.text: Blend 1 can of drained beans, 3 tablespoons of olive oil, the juice and zest of 1 lemon, 1 sprig of rosemary, and 1 clove of garlic until completely smooth. Season well with salt.

steps.name: Serve
steps.text: Spread in a bowl, drizzle with more olive oil, and serve with crackers.

meals.notes: This also works brilliantly spread thickly on toast and topped with roasted cherry tomatoes.
meals.photo_search: bowl of creamy white bean dip with olive oil, lemon, and rosemary, served with crackers
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of bowl of creamy white bean dip with olive oil, lemon, and rosemary, served with crackers
meals.headnote: A wide dish makes White Bean Dip with Lemon and Rosemary feel generous. Spread it out, add cannellini or butter beans as the sharp or savory finish, and bring the crisp things to the table separately.
meals.seoTitle: White Bean Dip with Lemon and Rosemary Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Blended white beans with olive oil and lemon. A more interesting alternative to hummus. Made for one in 8 minutes, with cannellini or butter beans and lemon.
meals.substitutions: Use 2 teaspoons of white wine vinegar if lemon is unavailable, adding it gradually to taste. Butter beans make an equally creamy dip, and thyme or sage can replace rosemary.
meals.storage: Refrigerate in a sealed container for up to four days. Stir before serving and refresh the surface with cannellini or butter beans or a little olive oil if it tightens.

meals.name: Egg Yolk Garlic Pasta
meals.description: Garlic pasta finished with an egg yolk. A solo carbonara for when you cannot be bothered.

steps.name: Cook pasta and garlic
steps.text: Boil 100g of pasta in salted water. Toast 3 cloves of sliced garlic in 2 tablespoons of olive oil until golden, saving pasta water.

steps.name: Combine
steps.text: Toss hot pasta with the oil and a splash of pasta water off heat. Let cool slightly, then add 1 egg yolk and toss rapidly to create a creamy sauce.

steps.name: Finish
steps.text: Add 30g of grated parmesan, toss, and season with chilli flakes and black pepper.

meals.notes: Letting the pasta cool very slightly before adding the yolk is what prevents scrambled eggs.
meals.photo_search: bowl of spaghetti in a creamy garlic sauce with grated parmesan and chilli flakes
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of bowl of spaghetti in a creamy garlic sauce with grated parmesan and chilli flakes
meals.headnote: Egg Yolk Garlic Pasta comes together when the noodles finish in the sauce. Keep garlic close, save some cooking water, and stop as soon as the bowl turns glossy.
meals.seoTitle: Egg Yolk Garlic Pasta Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Garlic pasta finished with an egg yolk. A solo carbonara for when you cannot be bothered. A pasta recipe for one, ready in 15 minutes with garlic.
meals.substitutions: Different short pasta shapes swap freely here. No garlic? Pecorino, asiago, or extra-black-pepper parmesan covers the same role in the sauce.
meals.storage: The sauce keeps covered for two days, while the pasta is best revived in a pan over low heat. Add egg yolk after warming so its flavor stays clear.

meals.name: 4th of July Burrata Plate
meals.description: Red, white, and blue on a plate. Creamy burrata, sweet strawberries, and blueberries for a festive, no cook girl dinner.

ingredients.name: flaky sea salt and black pepper

steps.name: Arrange
steps.text: Place the burrata in the center of a plate. Arrange the halved strawberries and blueberries around it in distinct sections to emphasize the red, white, and blue colors. Tuck in fresh mint or basil leaves if using.

steps.name: Dress and Serve
steps.text: Drizzle the burrata and fruit generously with olive oil and balsamic glaze. Season with flaky sea salt and black pepper. Serve immediately with crackers or toasted baguette for scooping.

meals.notes: The ultimate 4th of July girl dinner. No cooking, just aesthetic snacking. Use fresh, in-season berries for the best flavor and sweetness.
meals.photo_search: dark moody plate with burrata, fresh strawberries, blueberries, balsamic glaze, and crackers overhead flatlay food photography
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of dark moody plate with burrata, fresh strawberries, blueberries, balsamic glaze, and crackers overhead flatlay food photography
meals.headnote: Treat 4th of July Burrata Plate like a small composed meal. Put fresh burrata at the center, use strawberries to keep the plate lively, and add the sharp or salty finish just before eating.
meals.seoTitle: 4th of July Burrata Plate Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Red, white, and blue on a plate. Creamy burrata, sweet strawberries, and blueberries for a festive, no cook girl dinner.
meals.substitutions: Swap fresh burrata for whatever is already open in the fridge, and let strawberries keep its original contrast. The formula matters more than the parts: substance, crunch, and something sharp to cut through.
meals.storage: The assembled plate loses its contrast in the fridge. Chill fresh burrata in a covered container, keep strawberries sealed on its own, and rebuild the portions at serving time.

meals.name: Stracciatella with Olive Oil and Grilled Bread
meals.description: Creamy stracciatella drizzled with olive oil and black pepper. The simplest luxury.

ingredients.name: flaky sea salt and cracked black pepper
chilli oil, honey, fresh herbs, or lemon zest

steps.name: Set up
steps.text: Spoon 80g of stracciatella onto a plate. Take a moment to check the texture and seasoning before moving to the next step.

steps.name: Finish
steps.text: Drizzle generously with 2 tablespoons of excellent olive oil and season with flaky salt and cracked black pepper.  Serve alongside toasted sourdough for scooping.

meals.notes: Stracciatella is the creamy filling from burrata. Many Italian delis sell it separately.
meals.photo_search: plate of creamy stracciatella cheese drizzled with olive oil, served with grilled bread
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of plate of creamy stracciatella cheese drizzled with olive oil, served with grilled bread
meals.headnote: The arrangement is part of Stracciatella with Olive Oil and Grilled Bread. Leave stracciatella or burrata cream and flaky sea salt and cracked black pepper in their own spaces, then let the creamy, crisp, and briny parts meet in different combinations.
meals.seoTitle: Stracciatella with Olive Oil and Grilled Bread | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Creamy stracciatella drizzled with olive oil and black pepper. The simplest luxury.
meals.substitutions: No stracciatella or burrata cream? Any cheese, hummus, or tinned fish can anchor the plate. Keep one creamy thing, one crisp thing, and one briny thing and the board still works.
meals.storage: Keep stracciatella or burrata cream and flaky sea salt and cracked black pepper in separate containers and assemble the plate just before eating. Refrigerate cut ingredients for up to two days, but keep crackers and crisps dry.

meals.name: Frittata for One
meals.description: Open face Italian omelette with whatever is in the fridge. Elegant and effortless.

ingredients.name: sliced cherry tomatoes, sauteed spinach, leftover potato, herbs, cheese

steps.name: Beat eggs
steps.text: Whisk 3 large eggs with 2 tablespoons of milk, 30g of grated parmesan, salt, and pepper.

steps.name: Cook
steps.text: Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in an oven safe pan, add fillings, and pour in the eggs. Cook over medium heat until edges set.

steps.name: Finish under broiler
steps.text: Transfer pan to broiler for 2 to 3 minutes until golden and just set. Slice and serve from the pan.

meals.notes: Unlike an omelette, a frittata is never folded. It is finished under the broiler and sliced like a pizza.
meals.photo_search: small skillet frittata with cherry tomatoes and herbs, sliced and golden
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of small skillet frittata with cherry tomatoes and herbs, sliced and golden
meals.headnote: Frittata for One is simple food with no room to hide overcooking. Keep the heat controlled, let eggs warm through, and stop when the center still looks a little loose.
meals.seoTitle: Frittata for One Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Open face Italian omelette with whatever is in the fridge. Elegant and effortless. A eggs recipe for one, ready in 17 minutes with eggs.
meals.substitutions: Out of whole milk or cream? Whatever needs using up works instead. Keep the method identical and season in layers so the eggs stay the main event.
meals.storage: If saving a portion, refrigerate it covered for one day. Reheat slowly so the eggs stay tender, then add whole milk or cream at the end for contrast.

meals.name: Labneh with Za'atar and Olive Oil
meals.description: Strained yogurt cheese with za'atar and olive oil. The Middle Eastern answer to cream cheese.

steps.name: Plate
steps.text: Spread 1/2 cup of labneh in a wide bowl. Drizzle with 2 tablespoons of olive oil and dust heavily with 1 tablespoon of za'atar. Serve with warm pita, radishes, and cucumber.

meals.notes: Za'atar is a blend of dried thyme, sesame seeds, sumac, and salt. Find it at any Middle Eastern grocery.
meals.photo_search: bowl of labneh drizzled with olive oil and dusted with za'atar, served with pita
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of bowl of labneh drizzled with olive oil and dusted with za'atar, served with pita
meals.headnote: Use a shallow bowl for Labneh with Za'atar and Olive Oil so labneh or thick Greek yogurt and the finishing oil or herbs have room to show up in every scoop. Taste before adding more salt.
meals.seoTitle: Labneh with Za'atar and Olive Oil Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Strained yogurt cheese with za'atar and olive oil. The Middle Eastern answer to cream cheese.
meals.substitutions: No labneh or thick Greek yogurt? White beans, roasted eggplant, or extra yogurt blend into an equally dippable base. Taste and re-salt after blending.
meals.storage: Refrigerate the labneh mixture in a covered container for up to three days. Keep pita and vegetables separate, then add fresh olive oil and za'atar after the labneh has lost some of its refrigerator chill.

meals.name: Pasta e Fagioli
meals.description: Italian peasant soup. Pasta and white beans in a rich tomato rosemary broth.

ingredients.name: parmesan rind in pot, extra olive oil, grated parmesan

steps.name: Build base
steps.text: Saute 2 cloves of minced garlic in 2 tablespoons of olive oil until golden. Add 1/2 can of crushed tomatoes, 1 cup of broth, 1 sprig of rosemary, and a parmesan rind. Simmer 10 minutes.

steps.name: Add beans and pasta
steps.text: Add half of the 1 can of beans whole and mash the rest to thicken. Add 50g of small pasta and cook until tender.

steps.name: Serve
steps.text: Ladle into a bowl, drizzle with oil, and add grated parmesan.

meals.notes: Adding a parmesan rind to the pot while it simmers adds incredible depth to the broth.
meals.photo_search: bowl of pasta e fagioli soup with white beans, small pasta, and a drizzle of olive oil
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of bowl of pasta e fagioli soup with white beans, small pasta, and a drizzle of olive oil
meals.headnote: Pasta e Fagioli is a small pot, so every minute changes the texture. Build the broth in stages, stop before cannellini beans loses its shape, and serve it hot.

steps.text: Spread 2 tablespoons of sour cream, 1/4 cup of beef or beans, a handful of cheese, 1 tostada, a handful of lettuce, and 2 tablespoons of salsa in the center of a large tortilla.

steps.name: Fold
steps.text: Fold the edges up in pleats all the way around. Press flat.

steps.name: Toast
steps.text: Cook in a dry pan seam side down over medium heat, pressing down, until golden and sealed.

meals.notes: The tostada in the middle is the key structural element. It gives you that crunchy layer.

ingredients.name: fresh or dried figs, halved or sliced

steps.text: Spread 3 tablespoons of ricotta on toasted sourdough until the surface is golden and the edges are crisp. Move it to a plate while it is still hot.

steps.name: Top
steps.text: Layer 2 slices of prosciutto and sliced figs.  Drizzle with honey or balsamic glaze and season with flaky salt and pepper.

meals.notes: Fresh figs in season are extraordinary here. Out of season, good dried figs or fig jam both work.

meals.name: Anchovy Butter Toast
meals.description: For the umami obsessed. Anchovies mashed into butter on very good toast.

steps.name: Make anchovy butter
steps.text: Mash 3 to 4 anchovy fillets and 2 tablespoons of butter with a fork until combined, adding a squeeze of lemon.

steps.name: Spread
steps.text: Spread generously on hot toast. Top with sliced radishes and parsley if using.

meals.notes: Anchovies in butter lose their fishiness and become pure savory depth. Anyone who thinks they do not like anchovies usually likes this.

meals.name: Stuffed Bell Pepper with Rice and Feta
meals.description: Two halves of roasted bell pepper filled with herby rice and feta. Easy solo dinner.

steps.name: Roast pepper
steps.text: Brush 1 halved bell pepper with 2 tablespoons of oil and roast at 400F/200C for 15 minutes to soften.

steps.name: Make filling
steps.text: Mix 1/2 cup of cooked rice, 50g of crumbled feta, a handful of tomatoes, herbs, and a drizzle of olive oil. Season well.

steps.name: Fill and finish
steps.text: Fill the peppers with rice mixture and bake another 15 to 20 minutes until golden.

meals.notes: Any leftover rice works perfectly here. Great meal to make when you have rice from the night before.

meals.name: Carbonara for One
meals.description: True carbonara. No cream, just eggs, guanciale, and pecorino. Perfect.

steps.name: Render guanciale
steps.text: Cook 50g of guanciale in a cold pan over medium heat until fat renders and edges crisp. Remove from heat.

steps.name: Make sauce
steps.text: Whisk 1 egg, 1 yolk, 30g of pecorino, and 20g of parmesan together with generous black pepper.

steps.name: Combine carefully
steps.text: Add hot pasta to the guanciale pan off heat. Add egg mixture, tossing rapidly, adding pasta water gradually until silky.

meals.notes: If the pan sizzles when the egg mixture goes in, it is too hot. Toss the pasta for 20 to 30 seconds first, then add the eggs and loosen with hot pasta water.
meals.photo_search: bowl of spaghetti carbonara with crispy guanciale and a heavy dusting of black pepper
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of bowl of spaghetti carbonara with crispy guanciale and a heavy dusting of black pepper
meals.headnote: Carbonara succeeds in the minute after the pasta leaves the water. Let the guanciale pan cool briefly, toss off the heat, and add reserved pasta water a spoonful at a time until the egg and cheese become glossy rather than scrambled.
meals.seoTitle: Carbonara for One: Creamy 20-Minute Recipe | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: True carbonara. No cream, just eggs, guanciale, and pecorino. Perfect. Guanciale or pancetta and Pecorino Romano make this pasta recipe for one in 20 minutes.
meals.substitutions: Pancetta is the closest replacement for guanciale; bacon works but adds smoke. Use all Pecorino Romano for a sharper sauce or combine pecorino and parmesan for a gentler one. Spaghetti, bucatini, and rigatoni all work.
meals.storage: Carbonara is best eaten immediately. Refrigerate leftovers for up to one day, then warm very gently with a splash of water; high heat will tighten the egg sauce and make it grainy.

steps.text: Spread 2 tablespoons of cream cheese on thick cucumber rounds. Top with 60g of smoked salmon and dust with 1 tablespoon of everything bagel seasoning. Add capers or dill.

meals.name: Creamy Mushroom Toast with Thyme
meals.description: Sauteed mushrooms in garlic and thyme, splashed with cream, on thick buttered toast.

steps.name: Brown the mushrooms
steps.text: Heat the butter and olive oil in a wide skillet over medium-high heat. Add the mushrooms in an even layer and leave them undisturbed for 3 to 4 minutes, until deeply browned underneath. Toss and cook for 2 minutes more.

steps.name: Add the aromatics
steps.text: Lower the heat to medium. Add the garlic and thyme and cook for 30 seconds, just until fragrant. Pour in the cream and simmer for 1 to 2 minutes, until it lightly coats the mushrooms.

steps.name: Season and serve
steps.text: Season with salt, black pepper, and a small squeeze of lemon. Spoon the creamy mushrooms over the hot buttered sourdough and serve before the toast loses its crunch.

meals.notes: Do not stir mushrooms immediately. Letting them brown first is what creates the deep savory flavor.

meals.imageAlt: Photograph of sourdough toast piled high with mushrooms in a creamy garlic thyme sauce

meals.name: Crispy Fried Rice

ingredients.name: frozen peas, chilli crisp, leftover protein

steps.name: Fry rice
steps.text: Press 1 cup of cold rice into a hot pan with 2 tbsp oil and let it crisp without stirring. Push aside, scramble 2 eggs, and fold through.

steps.name: Add eggs
steps.text: Add 2 tsp soy sauce, toss, and finish with 1 tsp sesame oil and 2 sliced spring onions.

meals.notes: Cold day old rice is non negotiable. Fresh rice is too wet and will steam instead of fry.

meals.imageAlt: Photograph of plate of crispy fried rice with scrambled egg and spring onions

steps.text: Rub 1 halved garlic clove firmly over 2 slices of hot toast. Rub 1 halved tomato over the toast, squeezing gently to stain the bread red.

steps.name: Finish
steps.text: Drizzle with 2 tablespoons of olive oil and flaky salt.

steps.text: Pile on a plate with flaky salt. Eat immediately by the stem.
