meals.seoTitle: Spicy Tuna Crispy Rice Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Sushi grade tuna, sesame spiced and piled onto shatteringly crispy pan fried rice cakes. Made for one in 25 minutes, with sushi grade tuna and soy sauce.
meals.substitutions: Sushi grade tuna can become whatever you have on hand. Keep portions honest for one and season louder than you think for such a small plate.
meals.storage: This is best straight away. If sushi grade tuna or soy sauce needs to wait, cover it separately for one day and reassemble so the crisp parts do not soften.

meals.name: Takis with Chamoy and Lime
meals.description: Takis with fresh lime, chamoy, Tajin, cucumber, and mango for a spicy, sour five-minute snack plate.

ingredients.name: Takis Fuego or Flamin Hot Cheetos

steps.name: Plate
steps.text: Pour 1 bag of chips into a wide bowl. Drizzle with half the chamoy and lime, toss gently, then repeat only if needed. Dust with Tajin and serve immediately with cucumber, mango, or jicama on the side.

meals.notes: Start with half the chamoy and lime, toss, then taste. Takis are already salty and acidic, so a lighter hand keeps the chile and corn flavors recognizable.
meals.photo_search: plate of Takis chips drizzled with chamoy, lime juice, and Tajin seasoning
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of plate of Takis chips drizzled with chamoy, lime juice, and Tajin seasoning
meals.headnote: Add lime and chamoy in two light passes, tossing between each, so the seasoning coats the Takis without pooling at the bottom. Serve cucumber, mango, or jicama alongside for a cool, crisp contrast.
meals.seoTitle: Takis with Lime and Chamoy (5-Minute Snack) | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Make Takis with lime, chamoy, Tajin, cucumber, and mango in five minutes. A spicy, sour snack plate with plenty of crunch.
meals.substitutions: Flamin Hot Cheetos or sturdy tortilla chips can replace Takis. Use Valentina or another tangy hot sauce if chamoy is unavailable, and add extra mango or cucumber when you want less heat.
meals.storage: Dress only the amount you plan to eat because lime and chamoy soften the chips quickly. Keep unopened chips at room temperature and refrigerate cut fruit separately for up to one day.

meals.name: Overnight Oats as Dinner
meals.description: The reverse breakfast dinner. Prepared oats with toppings eaten at any hour.

ingredients.name: berries, banana, granola, nut butter, coconut flakes

steps.name: Mix
steps.text: Combine 1/2 cup of oats, 1/2 cup of milk, 1/4 cup of yogurt, 1 tbsp chia seeds, and 1 tbsp sweetener in a jar. Stir well, cover, and refrigerate overnight.

steps.name: Top
steps.text: When ready to eat, add toppings. Thin with a splash of milk if needed.

meals.notes: Works as a make ahead dinner too. Prep in the afternoon and eat in the evening.
meals.photo_search: jar of overnight oats topped with berries, chia seeds, and a drizzle of nut butter
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of jar of overnight oats topped with berries, chia seeds, and a drizzle of nut butter
meals.headnote: Use a wide bowl for Overnight Oats as Dinner so rolled oats and milk or oat milk have room to stay distinct. Season the base first and taste again after the toppings are in place.
meals.seoTitle: Overnight Oats as Dinner Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: The reverse breakfast dinner. Prepared oats with toppings eaten at any hour. Rolled oats and milk or oat milk make this bowl recipe for one in 5 minutes.
meals.substitutions: This bowl survives substitutions well. Trade rolled oats for tofu, a fried egg, or last night's vegetables and keep the sauce constant.
meals.storage: Cool cooked components promptly and refrigerate for three days. Bring the base back with gentle heat, then add rolled oats and any crunch at the table.

meals.name: Creamed Spinach on Toast
meals.description: Classic steakhouse creamed spinach reduced down to a solo toast topping. Rich and ridiculous.

steps.name: Wilt spinach
steps.text: Wilt 200g of spinach in 2 tbsp butter with 1 clove of minced garlic. Add 3 tbsp cream, 30g parmesan, and a pinch of nutmeg until thickened.

steps.name: Cream
steps.text: Taste the creamed spinach and adjust the salt and pepper. Pile it over the hot buttered sourdough, then finish with a little more parmesan while the topping is still steaming.

meals.notes: Squeeze out excess liquid from the wilted spinach before adding cream to prevent a watery sauce.
meals.photo_search: sourdough toast topped with rich creamed spinach and parmesan
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of sourdough toast topped with rich creamed spinach and parmesan
meals.headnote: Build Creamed Spinach on Toast in the order the textures need. Get the bread crisp, season baby spinach directly, and save butter for the final pass so every bite has some snap.
meals.seoTitle: Creamed Spinach on Toast Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Classic steakhouse creamed spinach reduced down to a solo toast topping. Rich and ridiculous. Made for one in 15 minutes, with baby spinach and butter.
meals.substitutions: No baby spinach? Soft cheeses, mashed avocado, or ricotta play the same role, while butter can keep the topping interesting. Whatever the spread, season it directly instead of salting only the top.
meals.storage: Toast cannot be stored assembled. Keep baby spinach and butter covered away from the bread, then toast a fresh slice and rebuild it when you are ready.

meals.name: Mango with Tajin and Lime
meals.description: Sweet ripe mango sliced and dusted with Tajin and lime. The refreshing solo dessert dinner.

ingredients.name: chamoy drizzle, chilli flakes, fresh mint

steps.name: Slice
steps.text: Stand the mango upright and cut the flesh away from both sides of the pit. Score or peel the pieces, then cut them into slices or bite-size cubes.

steps.name: Season
steps.text: Arrange on a plate. Squeeze half a lime over, dust generously with 1 tsp Tajin. Drizzle with chamoy if using.

meals.notes: The mango must be ripe. Under ripe mango with chilli is just confusing.
meals.photo_search: plate of fresh mango slices dusted with Tajin and lime juice
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of plate of fresh mango slices dusted with Tajin and lime juice
meals.headnote: Mango with Tajin and Lime has a clear payoff for very little work. Keep the components recognizable, taste before serving, and let Tajin seasoning provide the final lift.
meals.seoTitle: Mango with Tajin and Lime Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Sweet ripe mango sliced and dusted with Tajin and lime. The refreshing solo dessert dinner. A snack recipe for one, ready in 5 minutes with ripe mango.
meals.substitutions: Ripe mango can become whatever you have on hand. Keep portions honest for one and season louder than you think for such a small plate.
meals.storage: Keep ripe mango and Tajin seasoning in separate containers if saving a portion. Refrigerate overnight at most, then restore the crunch or warmth before serving.

meals.name: Solo Charcuterie Board with Wine
meals.description: A proper small board built for one, with wine. This is aspirational solo dining.

steps.name: Build the board
steps.text: Place 40g of manchego and 40g of brie at opposite corners of a board. Fold 30g of prosciutto and 30g of salami and fill gaps with olives, fruit, and 1 tbsp of nuts. Add crackers and pour a glass of wine.

steps.name: Eat slowly
steps.text: Let the cheese lose its refrigerator chill, then graze slowly and change the combinations as you go. Keep the crackers dry and pour the wine only when the board is ready.

meals.notes: Never rush a board. The whole point is that you eat slowly and enjoy it.
meals.photo_search: small wooden board with prosciutto, manchego, brie, olives, grapes, and a glass of wine
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of small wooden board with prosciutto, manchego, brie, olives, grapes, and a glass of wine
meals.headnote: Solo Charcuterie Board with Wine works because the bite keeps changing: prosciutto or coppa gives it an anchor and soppressata or salami brings contrast. Keep the pieces distinct and build each forkful as you go.
meals.seoTitle: Solo Charcuterie Board with Wine Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: A proper small board built for one, with wine. This is aspirational solo dining. A snack plate recipe for one, ready in 10 minutes with prosciutto or coppa.
meals.substitutions: No prosciutto or coppa? Any cheese, hummus, or tinned fish can anchor the plate. Keep one creamy thing, one crisp thing, and one briny thing and the board still works.
meals.storage: The assembled plate loses its contrast in the fridge. Chill prosciutto or coppa in a covered container, keep soppressata or salami sealed on its own, and rebuild the portions at serving time.

meals.name: Honey Garlic Butter Shrimp
meals.description: Shrimp cooked in 5 minutes in a sticky honey garlic butter. Eat with bread or rice.

ingredients.name: raw shrimp or prawns, peeled and deveined

steps.name: Season shrimp
steps.text: Pat 150g of shrimp dry and season with salt and pepper.

steps.name: Cook
steps.text: Add the shrimp and cook for 2 to 3 minutes per side, until opaque, curled, and 145°F (63°C) in the center. Pour in the honey sauce and toss for 1 minute, until it glazes the shrimp.

meals.notes: Patting shrimp completely dry before cooking is what lets them sear rather than steam.
meals.photo_search: skillet of shrimp in a sticky honey garlic butter sauce with lemon
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of skillet of shrimp in a sticky honey garlic butter sauce with lemon
meals.headnote: The portion in Honey Garlic Butter Shrimp is practical without feeling slight. Read the method once, watch for the doneness cue, and keep garlic ready for the hot plate.
meals.seoTitle: Honey Garlic Butter Shrimp Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Shrimp cooked in 5 minutes in a sticky honey garlic butter. Eat with bread or rice. Made for one in 13 minutes, with raw shrimp or prawns and garlic.
meals.substitutions: Protein here is a suggestion, not a rule. Swap raw shrimp or prawns freely and let the sauce and timing lead; check doneness a few minutes early either way.
meals.storage: Refrigerate leftovers covered for up to three days. Reheat gently until hot throughout, adding a splash of water if raw shrimp or prawns or the sauce looks dry.

meals.name: Smoked Oyster Toast
meals.description: A tin of smoked oysters on buttered rye toast with hot sauce. Deeply underrated girl dinner.

ingredients.name: hot sauce, lemon juice, cracked pepper

steps.name: Toast and butter
steps.text: Toast 2 slices of bread until deeply golden. Butter generously with 2 tbsp of butter.

steps.name: Top
steps.text: Lay 1 tin of smoked oysters on toast. Add hot sauce, a squeeze of lemon, and black pepper. Add cream cheese and shallot if using.

meals.notes: Taste an oyster before salting. Most tins are already well seasoned, and lemon plus hot sauce usually provides all the brightness the toast needs.
meals.photo_search: rye toast heavily buttered and topped with smoked oysters, hot sauce, and lemon
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of rye toast heavily buttered and topped with smoked oysters, hot sauce, and lemon
meals.headnote: Toast the bread until the center is crisp enough to support the oil from the oysters. Drain the tin lightly rather than completely, then balance its smoke and richness with lemon, hot sauce, black pepper, and sliced shallot.
meals.seoTitle: Smoked Oyster Toast Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: A tin of smoked oysters on buttered rye toast with hot sauce. Deeply underrated girl dinner. A toast recipe for one, ready in 6 minutes with smoked oysters.
meals.substitutions: Smoked mussels or trout can replace the oysters. Use rye for a firm, savory base or sourdough for more tang. Cream cheese is optional, but if using it, spread a thin layer so it does not bury the oyster flavor.
meals.storage: Transfer unused oysters and their oil to a covered container and refrigerate for up to two days. Toast fresh bread when serving leftovers; assembled oyster toast turns soft in storage.

meals.name: Roasted Beet and Goat Cheese Salad
meals.description: Earthy roasted beets, tangy goat cheese, and candied walnuts. Classic bistro salad.

ingredients.name: pre cooked beets (vacuum packed, not pickled), sliced

steps.name: Make dressing
steps.text: Whisk together 1 tbsp balsamic, 2 tbsp olive oil, and 1 tsp dijon. Season.

steps.name: Assemble
steps.text: Dress 2 handfuls of arugula lightly and arrange with 1 pack of sliced beets, 2 tbsp of crumbled goat cheese, and a handful of candied walnuts.

meals.notes: Pre roasted vacuum packed beets are a completely valid shortcut and nearly as good as roasting your own.
meals.photo_search: plate of arugula, sliced roasted beets, crumbled goat cheese, and candied walnuts
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of plate of arugula, sliced roasted beets, crumbled goat cheese, and candied walnuts
meals.headnote: The method for Roasted Beet and Goat Cheese Salad is mostly tasting. Start with the dressing, add pre cooked beets, and keep enough soft goat cheese in reserve to restore crunch and brightness at the end.
meals.seoTitle: Roasted Beet and Goat Cheese Salad Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Earthy roasted beets, tangy goat cheese, and candied walnuts. Classic bistro salad. Made for one in 5 minutes, with pre cooked beets and soft goat cheese.
meals.substitutions: Greens swap freely by season. Without pre cooked beets, toasted nuts or seeds restore the crunch the salad is counting on.
meals.storage: Make the components ahead, but do not finish the salad until serving. Refrigerate soft goat cheese separately so the bowl keeps its snap.

meals.name: Tteokbokki
meals.description: Chewy Korean rice cakes simmered in a glossy, spicy-sweet gochujang sauce, scaled for one.

ingredients.name: cylindrical rice cakes (tteok), fresh or frozen
fish cake slices, boiled egg, spring onion, sesame seeds

steps.name: Make sauce
steps.text: Combine 2 tbsp gochujang, 1 tbsp soy, and 1 tbsp sugar in a pan with 1 cup of water. Stir over medium heat until combined.

steps.name: Cook rice cakes
steps.text: Add 200g of rice cakes and simmer 8 to 10 minutes until soft and the sauce reduces to a thick glaze.

steps.name: Serve
steps.text: Spoon the rice cakes and plenty of sauce into a shallow bowl. Finish with sliced spring onions and sesame seeds, then eat while the sauce is glossy and the rice cakes are soft and chewy.

meals.notes: Soak frozen rice cakes in cold water for 20 minutes before cooking. If the sauce thickens before the centers are tender, add water two tablespoons at a time and keep simmering.
meals.photo_search: bowl of tteokbokki rice cakes in a thick red gochujang sauce with spring onions
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of bowl of tteokbokki rice cakes in a thick red gochujang sauce with spring onions
meals.headnote: Soak refrigerated or frozen rice cakes until they bend without cracking, then simmer rather than boil aggressively. The sauce is ready when it clings to each rice cake in a glossy coat but still moves across the pan.
meals.seoTitle: Easy Tteokbokki for One (20-Minute Recipe) | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Make easy tteokbokki for one with chewy Korean rice cakes and a spicy-sweet gochujang sauce. Ready in about 20 minutes.
meals.substitutions: Flat rice-cake slices work in place of cylinders but cook faster. Add fish cake, a halved boiled egg, or napa cabbage for a fuller bowl. There is no close substitute for gochujang; reducing the amount is better than replacing it with plain hot sauce.
meals.storage: Refrigerate leftovers covered for up to three days. Reheat gently until hot throughout, adding a splash of water if cylindrical rice cakes or the sauce looks dry.

meals.name: Tahini and Honey Toast
meals.description: Nutty tahini with honey and sesame seeds. A two ingredient toast that is weirdly addictive.

steps.name: Toast
steps.text: Toast the bread until deeply golden, crisp at the edges, and still a little tender in the center. Move it to a plate while it is hot.

steps.name: Top
steps.text: Spread 2 tbsp of tahini generously while bread is hot. Drizzle 1 tbsp honey over the top. Finish with a pinch of flaky salt and sesame seeds.

meals.notes: Good tahini is essential. It should be pourable and smell nutty. If it tastes bitter it is a bad batch.
meals.photo_search: toasted bread spread with tahini, drizzled with honey, and sprinkled with sesame seeds
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of toasted bread spread with tahini, drizzled with honey, and sprinkled with sesame seeds
meals.headnote: The small details make Tahini and Honey Toast feel like dinner: deep browning underneath, enough seasoning in tahini, and honey added while the toast is still hot.
meals.seoTitle: Tahini and Honey Toast Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Nutty tahini with honey and sesame seeds. A two ingredient toast that is weirdly addictive. A toast recipe for one, ready in 5 minutes with tahini.
meals.substitutions: Out of tahini? Try honey instead, or use any combination of something creamy over something briny. Thick bread forgives almost any topping swap.
meals.storage: Store the topping separately for up to two days and keep the bread dry. Re-toast until crisp before adding tahini so the last bite still has structure.

meals.name: Store-Bought Pork Belly Bao
meals.description: Using supermarket char siu pork belly and frozen steamed buns. Restaurant at home.

ingredients.name: store bought char siu or roast pork belly, sliced

steps.name: Steam buns
steps.text: Steam the frozen bao according to the package directions until puffed, soft, and hot through. Keep them covered off the heat so the surfaces do not dry out.

steps.name: Warm pork
steps.text: Warm 100g of pork belly slices in a hot pan until edges caramelize.

steps.name: Build
steps.text: Open bao, spread 2 tbsp hoisin inside, add pork, pickled vegetables, cilantro, and 1 tsp sriracha.

meals.notes: Frozen bao buns are available at most Asian supermarkets and steam back to perfect in minutes.
meals.photo_search: fluffy steamed bao buns filled with pork belly, hoisin sauce, and cucumber
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of fluffy steamed bao buns filled with pork belly, hoisin sauce, and cucumber
meals.headnote: A short ingredient list lets Store-Bought Pork Belly Bao depend on texture. Season frozen steamed bao buns in stages, cook until the center is ready, and finish with something fresh or sharp.
meals.seoTitle: Store-Bought Pork Belly Bao Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Using supermarket char siu pork belly and frozen steamed buns. Restaurant at home. A main recipe for one, ready in 15 minutes with frozen steamed bao buns.
meals.substitutions: Small flour tortillas or lettuce cups can replace steamed bao buns. Char siu, roast pork, shredded chicken, or crisp tofu all work with hoisin and pickled vegetables.
meals.storage: Save leftovers in a sealed container for up to three days. Reheat slowly and finish with frozen steamed bao buns at the table rather than cooking the fresh element twice.

meals.name: Olive Oil Cake with Macerated Berries
meals.description: A slice of Italian olive oil cake with macerated berries as dinner. Acceptable and right.

ingredients.name: olive oil cake, bakery or homemade
whipped cream, mascarpone, or vanilla yogurt

steps.name: Macerate berries
steps.text: Toss 1 cup of berries with 1 tsp sugar and 1 tsp lemon juice for 10 minutes until they release their juice.

steps.name: Plate
steps.text: Serve 1 slice of cake alongside or topped with macerated berries and cream if using.

meals.notes: Olive oil cake from a good Italian bakery is one of the great things. If you cannot find it, it is also very easy to make.
meals.photo_search: plate with a slice of olive oil cake topped with juicy macerated berries
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of plate with a slice of olive oil cake topped with juicy macerated berries
meals.headnote: Olive Oil Cake with Macerated Berries has a clear payoff for very little work. Keep the components recognizable, taste before serving, and let sugar provide the final lift.
meals.seoTitle: Olive Oil Cake with Macerated Berries Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: A slice of Italian olive oil cake with macerated berries as dinner. Acceptable and right. Made for one in 5 minutes, with mixed berries and sugar.
meals.substitutions: Mixed berries can become whatever you have on hand. Keep portions honest for one and season louder than you think for such a small plate.
meals.storage: This is best straight away. If mixed berries or sugar needs to wait, cover it separately for one day and reassemble so the crisp parts do not soften.

meals.name: Butter Lettuce with Champagne Vinaigrette
meals.description: Tender butter lettuce tossed at the last minute with a bright champagne vinaigrette, parmesan, and toasted nuts.

ingredients.name: shaved parmesan, toasted hazelnuts, sliced radish

steps.name: Make vinaigrette
steps.text: Whisk 1 tbsp vinegar, 1 tsp dijon, and 1 clove of minced garlic together. Slowly stream in 3 tbsp olive oil until emulsified. Season with salt and white pepper.

steps.name: Dress and serve
steps.text: Gently toss 1 head of butter lettuce leaves with just enough dressing to coat lightly. Plate immediately and add parmesan or hazelnuts.

meals.notes: Dress the salad immediately before serving. Start with half the vinaigrette, toss gently with your hands, and add more only if the leaves still look dry.
meals.photo_search: elegant bowl of butter lettuce lightly coated in champagne vinaigrette with shaved parmesan
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of elegant bowl of butter lettuce lightly coated in champagne vinaigrette with shaved parmesan
meals.headnote: Wash the lettuce in cold water and dry it thoroughly so the vinaigrette can cling. Tear large leaves by hand, whisk the dressing until glossy, and toss with only half at first because butter lettuce wilts quickly.
meals.seoTitle: Butter Lettuce Salad with Champagne Vinaigrette | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Make butter lettuce salad with a bright champagne vinaigrette, parmesan, and toasted nuts. A light single-serving salad ready in 8 minutes.
meals.substitutions: White wine vinegar is the closest substitute for champagne vinegar; rice vinegar also works but is milder. Use toasted walnuts, hazelnuts, or almonds, and swap parmesan for crumbled goat cheese if preferred.
meals.storage: Keep washed, thoroughly dried lettuce covered with a dry paper towel for up to two days. Refrigerate the vinaigrette separately for up to one week and whisk again before using.

meals.name: Whipped Ricotta with Cherry Tomato Confit
meals.description: Silky whipped ricotta topped with sweet, blistered cherry tomatoes in olive oil.

ingredients.name: cherry tomato confit or blistered tomatoes
flaky sea salt, black pepper, fresh basil

steps.name: Whip
steps.text: Add 1/2 cup of ricotta and 1 tbsp olive oil to a food processor or bowl. Whip until completely smooth and fluffy, about 2 minutes.

steps.name: Plate
steps.text: Spoon the whipped ricotta into a shallow bowl. Top with 1/4 cup of cherry tomato confit, letting the oil pool slightly. Season with flaky salt, black pepper, and fresh basil. Serve with crackers.

meals.notes: For quick blistered tomatoes, cook them cut-side down in olive oil over medium-high heat until they collapse at the edges, then season with salt and basil.
meals.photo_search: bowl of creamy white whipped ricotta topped with bright red blistered cherry tomatoes and basil
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of bowl of creamy white whipped ricotta topped with bright red blistered cherry tomatoes and basil
meals.headnote: Drain watery ricotta before whipping so it becomes airy instead of loose. Spoon warm tomatoes and their flavored oil over the cold ricotta just before serving for a clear temperature and texture contrast.
meals.seoTitle: Whipped Ricotta with Cherry Tomato Confit | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Silky whipped ricotta topped with sweet, blistered cherry tomatoes in olive oil. A dip recipe for one, ready in 5 minutes with whole milk ricotta.
meals.substitutions: Roast halved cherry tomatoes at 425°F until blistered if confit is unavailable. Cottage cheese blended until smooth can replace ricotta, while toasted sourdough, pita, or sturdy crackers all work for scooping.
meals.storage: Refrigerate whipped ricotta and tomato confit in separate covered containers for up to three days. Bring the ricotta toward room temperature and warm the tomatoes gently before assembling.

meals.name: Smoked Trout and Apple Plate
meals.description: Smoky trout flaked over crisp apple slices with a mustard dressing.

steps.name: Make dressing
steps.text: Whisk together 1 tbsp dijon, 1 tsp honey, 1 tbsp olive oil, and a squeeze of lemon juice.

steps.name: Plate
steps.text: Arrange the apple slices on a plate. Flake the smoked trout over the apples. Drizzle with the honey mustard dressing.

meals.notes: Smoked trout is usually found in tins near the smoked salmon. It is cheaper and very flavorful.
meals.photo_search: plate of sliced green apples topped with flaked smoked trout and a honey mustard drizzle
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of plate of sliced green apples topped with flaked smoked trout and a honey mustard drizzle
meals.headnote: The arrangement is part of Smoked Trout and Apple Plate. Leave smoked trout and crisp apple in their own spaces, then let the creamy, crisp, and briny parts meet in different combinations.
meals.seoTitle: Smoked Trout and Apple Plate Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Smoky trout flaked over crisp apple slices with a mustard dressing. Made for one in 5 minutes, with smoked trout and crisp apple.
meals.substitutions: No smoked trout? Any cheese, hummus, or tinned fish can anchor the plate. Keep one creamy thing, one crisp thing, and one briny thing and the board still works.
meals.storage: Keep smoked trout and crisp apple in separate containers and assemble the plate just before eating. Refrigerate cut ingredients for up to two days, but keep crackers and crisps dry.

meals.name: Udon Noodles in Mentsuyu with Spinach
meals.description: Chewy udon noodles in a savory Japanese dipping broth with tender spinach.

ingredients.name: bonito flakes, sesame seeds, chili oil

steps.name: Make broth
steps.text: In a small pot, combine 1/4 cup mentsuyu and 1/2 cup water. Bring to a gentle simmer.

steps.name: Cook noodles
steps.text: Boil the frozen udon according to package directions. In the last 30 seconds, drop in the handful of spinach to wilt. Drain well.

steps.name: Serve
steps.text: Place the hot noodles and spinach in a deep bowl. Pour the hot broth over the top. Garnish with spring onions and optional toppings.

meals.notes: Mentsuyu is a concentrated Japanese soup base found in bottles at Asian markets. It is a pantry staple for fast meals.
meals.photo_search: deep bowl of udon noodles in clear broth with wilted spinach and spring onions
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of deep bowl of udon noodles in clear broth with wilted spinach and spring onions
meals.headnote: Taste the noodles in Udon Noodles in Mentsuyu with Spinach before trusting the package time. A pleasantly chewy center gives mentsuyu and the sauce something to cling to without turning the bowl soft.
meals.seoTitle: Udon Noodles in Mentsuyu with Spinach Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Chewy udon noodles in a savory Japanese dipping broth with tender spinach. A noodles recipe for one, ready in 10 minutes with mentsuyu.
meals.substitutions: Sauce bases swap freely if you are out of mentsuyu: peanut butter thinned with hot water, tahini plus soy, or simply more chilli oil each carry a bowl.
meals.storage: Refrigerate the noodles for up to one day and protect mentsuyu and baby spinach from moisture. They can be eaten cold or revived briefly in hot water before serving.

meals.name: Garlic Confit Bread
meals.description: Crisp toast smeared with soft, sweet garlic confit and flaky salt.

steps.name: Toast
steps.text: Toast the sourdough until deeply golden and crisp at the edges. Move it to a plate while it is hot so the garlic oil can soak into the rough surface.

steps.name: Smear
steps.text: While the toast is hot, drizzle with the garlic confit oil. Use a fork to smash the soft garlic confit cloves directly onto the bread. Sprinkle with flaky salt and fresh thyme.

meals.notes: Garlic confit is made by slowly poaching peeled garlic cloves in olive oil over very low heat until golden and soft. Make a big batch and keep it in the fridge.
meals.photo_search: sourdough toast smeared with soft golden garlic confit and sprinkled with flaky sea salt
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of sourdough toast smeared with soft golden garlic confit and sprinkled with flaky sea salt
meals.headnote: Garlic Confit Bread depends on a properly crisp base. Toast the bread until it can support garlic confit cloves, add flaky sea salt at the last minute, and eat it before the topping softens the edges.
meals.seoTitle: Garlic Confit Bread Recipe for One | foidslop
meals.seoDescription: Crisp toast smeared with soft, sweet garlic confit and flaky salt. Garlic confit cloves and flaky sea salt make this toast recipe for one in 5 minutes.
meals.substitutions: No garlic confit cloves? Soft cheeses, mashed avocado, or ricotta play the same role, while flaky sea salt can keep the topping interesting. Whatever the spread, season it directly instead of salting only the top.
meals.storage: Make the components ahead, not the finished toast. Cover garlic confit cloves, protect flaky sea salt from moisture, and assemble after the bread is hot and crisp.

meals.name: Cottage Cheese with Peaches and Hot Honey
meals.description: Creamy cottage cheese, ripe peaches, and hot honey make a sweet, spicy bowl with plenty of contrast.

steps.name: Assemble
steps.text: Scoop the cottage cheese into a bowl. Arrange the sliced peaches on top. Drizzle generously with hot honey and sprinkle with flaky salt and almonds.

meals.notes: The combination of sweet peaches, spicy honey, and creamy cheese is unexpectedly perfect.
meals.photo_search: bowl of cottage cheese topped with sliced peaches, hot honey, and almonds
meals.imageAlt: Photograph of bowl of cottage cheese topped with sliced peaches, hot honey, and almonds
